scientificClaim: Directional change in Bernoulli success probability at -7/8 compared with .5. Linear selects the decrease claim and quadratic selects increase.
budget: 12 observations maximum. Discovery uses the registered NOESIS selector and model. Fresh verification receives the remaining capacity. Unused verification observations after early stopping are discarded. Duplicate boundary repeats a single draw at each verification look, a deliberate dependence violation.
primary: For the stand-alone horizon-12 fixture: unadjusted repeated fixed-horizon threshold minus one-look fixed-horizon false report probability under the IID boundary null. For the integrated programme: cautious evidence process versus repeated unadjusted testing on total declared loss at discovery allocation 3 under the IID boundary.
loss: Nonnegative expected selected focal decision loss plus observation cost plus false-claim penalty minus reward for a true claim. A claim gates the NOESIS action forecast. Withheld claim defaults to reject. No test is interpreted as identifying a whole family.
